svg.aria-label: Comparison. An ordinary mock GPS app: every app on the phone gets a fake GPS position flagged mock = true, while the Wi-Fi scan and LTE cells stay real. Latebris on the hook path: an app in the LSPosed scope gets the preset position with mock = false, the preset Wi-Fi networks and the preset LTE cell; an app outside the scope gets the preset position flagged mock = true and its real Wi-Fi and cells.
